scope: Provide an editable Remote Infrastructure / SysAdmin example with the ten specified IT titles, remote required, and full-time employment. Saving uses the existing profile-scoped search API; users can select the persisted profile after reload to filter Jobs. Scheduled discovery remains disabled until the user enables it.

environment.frontend: local Vite production build and connected Chromium
environment.delivery: local-only; no push or hosted automation

acceptance: The user can load the documented ten-title example into editable search fields; loading does not save, submit, enable scheduling, or contact an external source.
The user can save it through the existing API. Connected browser readback verifies all titles, REQUIRED remote preference, FULL_TIME employment, no source restriction, and a disabled scheduler.
After reload, the saved search appears under the active profile. Selecting it in Jobs sends the persisted search_profile_id in the jobs query.
The example is profile-scoped, and the adjacent profile-isolation regression passes.

checks.evidence: 94 frontend test files and 536 tests passed.
TypeScript and Vite production build passed. Existing advisory: generated JavaScript chunk is 748.34 kB, above the 500 kB warning threshold.
Three connected Chromium acceptance tests passed. The seed test observed zero external requests, zero collection requests, and zero queued worker operations.
Changed Python tests compile and the source diff has no whitespace errors.

not_run: PostgreSQL search-profile persistence acceptance and the full Python repository suite.
Live external job-source collection; this seed verification deliberately made no provider request.
limitations: This delivers the example profile only; it does not imply that listed job sources have live coverage or that a matching job exists.
The user must explicitly choose a saved search and separately enable scheduled collection if desired.
safety: The seed loads draft field values only and creates no record until the user saves it.
Source selection resets to all enabled sources; schedule remains off by default.
The verification blocks all external browser requests and performs no application submission.
input_hash_note: input_sha256 records the exact feature-worktree bytes used for the first candidate tests. git_blob_sha256 records the canonical committed source blobs. Windows checkout line-ending conversion can make the main worktree byte hash differ; integrated-main frontend suite/build/connected browser checks were rerun successfully after fast-forward.
